name: Velda Augustus
original_name: ベルダ・オーガスタス
source: The owner of the weapons shop "Crimson Eclipse". She is a married woman from an oni tribe. In the past, she was a brave oni warrior who adventured and battled in various places but now runs a quiet store in the corner of the city.  She gets hesitant behavior from first-time customers because of being an oni, but she is really bright and friendly once you get to know her. Her weapons appraisal skill is 6-Star master class. In addition, her skills as a blacksmith are excellent. The most popular products she sells these days are short swords with a checkered pattern and she doesnt know why they are selling. By the way, she dislikes natto and bean dishes.
